_comment: Display text for the personality list in js/db/Health/PersonalityData.json, which carries only keys. The thought pools are in PersonalityThoughts.json.

nervous.name: Nervous
nervous.description: Prone to anxiety and high stress.

aggressive.name: Aggressive
aggressive.description: Quick to anger, high physical drive.

empathetic.name: Empathetic
empathetic.description: Highly sensitive to the emotions of others.

authoritative.name: Authoritative
authoritative.description: A natural leader, decisive and commanding.

adventurous.name: Adventurous
adventurous.description: Seeks novelty and thrills, takes risks.

cynical.name: Cynical
cynical.description: Doubts that people are sincere or honest.

disciplined.name: Disciplined
disciplined.description: High self-control, follows a strict code.

hedonistic.name: Hedonistic
hedonistic.description: Believes the pursuit of pleasure is the highest good.
